integrity.numerical_reproducibility: standalone check_lee.py using NumPy; finite floating-point checks

scientific_limitations: Only odd square tori of side length at least three and the critical Lee radius (N-1)/2 are addressed.
A plausible recent Lee-ball group-ring source was available as abstract only; older equivalent Fourier identities may exist.
Finite floating-point tests corroborate but do not establish the universal proof; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: A zero-free Fourier law and sharp inverse bound for half-radius Lee balls on odd square tori
